Class RequestContextUtils

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.servlet.support.RequestContextUtils
public abstract class RequestContextUtils extends Object
Utility class for easy access to request-specific state which has been set by the DispatcherServlet.

支持查找当前的 WebApplicationContext、LocaleResolver、Locale 和 MultipartResolver。

Since:
03.03.2003
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller，Rossen Stoyanchev

    • findWebApplicationContext

      public static @Nullable WebApplicationContext findWebApplicationContext(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request, @Nullable jakarta.servlet.ServletContext servletContext)
      Look for the WebApplicationContext associated with the DispatcherServlet that has initiated request processing, and for the global context if none was found associated with the current request. The global context will be found via the ServletContext or via ContextLoader's current context.

      注意：此变体与 Servlet 2.5 保持兼容，显式检查给定的 ServletContext，而不是从请求中推导它。

      Parameters:
      request - 当前 HTTP 请求
      - 当前 Servlet 上下文
      Returns:
      请求特定的 WebApplicationContext，或者如果未找到请求特定的上下文则为全局的，或者如果都没有则为`null`。
      Since:
      4.2.1
      See Also:
      • DispatcherServlet.WEB_APPLICATION_CONTEXT_ATTRIBUTE
      • WebApplicationContextUtils.getWebApplicationContext(ServletContext)
      • ContextLoader.getCurrentWebApplicationContext()

    • getLocale

      public static Locale getLocale(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request)
      Retrieve the current locale from the given request, using the LocaleResolver bound to the request by the DispatcherServlet (if available), falling back to the request's locale based on the Accept-Language header or the default locale for the server.

      此方法作为标准 Servlet `ServletRequest.getLocale()` 方法的简单替代方案，若未找到更具体的区域设置，则回退到后者。

      考虑使用LocaleContextHolder.getLocale()，它通常会被填充为相同的 Locale。

      Parameters:
      request - 当前 HTTP 请求
      Returns:
      给定请求的当前区域设置，要么来自 LocaleResolver，要么来自请求本身。
      See Also:
      • getLocaleResolver(HttpServletRequest)
      • LocaleContextHolder.getLocale()

    • getTimeZone

      public static @Nullable TimeZone getTimeZone(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request)
      Retrieve the current time zone from the given request, using the TimeZoneAwareLocaleContext in the LocaleResolver bound to the request by the DispatcherServlet (if available).

      注意：如果无法为给定请求解析出特定的时区，此方法将返回 null。这与 getLocale(HttpServletRequest) 形成对比，后者总是可以回退到基于 Accept-Language 头或服务器默认 locale 的请求 locale。

      考虑使用LocaleContextHolder.getTimeZone()，该方法通常会被填充为相同的TimeZone：此方法仅在LocaleResolver未提供特定时区（而不是本方法的null）时回退到系统时区方面有所不同。

      Parameters:
      request - 当前 HTTP 请求
      Returns:
      给定请求的当前时区，要么来自`TimeZoneAwareLocaleContext`，要么如果没有关联则为`null`。
      See Also:
      • getLocaleResolver(HttpServletRequest)
      • LocaleContextHolder.getTimeZone()
